system.description:
Smarts; 2 Pierce; Medium (50 ft). Variable ammo: an Interact Action swaps the loaded dart. Sleep Dart: a damaged enemy must pass a CR 1 Grit Check or be Paralysed. Poison Dart: a damaged enemy must pass a CR 1 Grit Check or gain Poisoned (1). Tracking Dart: leaves a glowing trail (no further rule is printed).

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.139

automation.note: Loaded dart. Sleep or Poison: keep the damaged target targeted, post the Dart Thrower to chat and click that dart's button (the target saves with Grit CR 1). Tracking: it leaves a trail of glowing liquid.
Variable ammo: switching between Sleep, Poison and Tracking darts costs an Interact Action. The book gives no way to end the Sleep Dart's Paralysed, so the Director decides when it wears off.
